name: Rose Lalonde
source:
Rose Lalonde is one of the main characters in Homestuck. She uses the chumhandle tentacleTherapist when chatting on Pesterchum. Her text color is purple (#B536DA).
Her web browser of choice is Cetus.

Her Associated Element is water, and her Associated Item is chalk.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Jade_Harley]MSPA Wiki[/url]].
